title: Tabular Data Generator
summary: A tabular data generator combining a Gaussian Mixture Model and a Variational Autoencoder, benchmarked against a state-of-the-art CTGAN baseline on adult, metabric and std datasets. It imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata to train and describe the SOTA baseline, and uses SDMetrics' QualityReport for validation.
needs: data_generation/output_sota/*/ctgan directories look like saved pretrained-model outputs rather than a vendored copy of the ctgan library; not verified as source code.
